sides.name: Normandy (William)
sides.note: Tech override per derived:tech-anchor (SOURCES.md anchor table, interpolated by year); air and cyber 0 = derived:absent-in-era. Ratings per derived:rating-rubric. Modern estimates 7,000-12,000 (7,000-8,000 incl. 1,000-2,000 cavalry; 10,000-12,000; 10,000 incl. 3,000 cavalry; 7,500). Mid 8,500. Composition about 1/2 infantry, 1/4 cavalry, 1/4 archers and crossbowmen. Contemporary 14,000-150,000 rejected. Command 0.8: William; feigned retreats used.

sides.name: England (Harold Godwinson)
sides.note: Tech override per derived:tech-anchor (SOURCES.md anchor table, interpolated by year); air and cyber 0 = derived:absent-in-era. Ratings per derived:rating-rubric. Modern estimates 5,000-13,000; almost all infantry, few archers. Housecarls and thegns as infantry_line, poorly equipped fyrd as infantry_light (split is an educated guess). Shield wall on Senlac ridge. Morale 0.65 and training 0.55: tired after Stamford Bridge (25 Sept) and the march south; elite housecarls mixed with fyrd.

outcome.note: Norman victory; Harold killed. Fighting from about 9 am to dusk (sunset 16:54). Casualties unknown: Marren speculates ~2,000 Norman and ~4,000 English dead; ~50% English fatality rate among known participants. Wounded added by educated guess.
